Name: Triple Shot Joja Cola
Author: Sledgehannah
Description:
If you have left over joja cola cans - maybe you've fished them up, found them in the trash, or even gone the joja route and now have a machine that makes one a day - then this mod will make those cans more useful! Buy the recipe for Triple Shot Joja Cola from the saloon for 3000g, and you can use your kitchen stove or cookout kit to combine 3 joja colas into 1 Triple Shot Joja Cola.

- Buy the recipe from the Saloon for 3000g
- Buffs: +1 speed for 3 minutes and 15 seconds (real time).

This buff is better than coffee, but not as good as triple shot espresso, so the recipe price reflects this.
 
[b][u]Install Instructions:[/u][/b]
Unzip the file and put the resulting folder in the Mods folder of your game folder.
For more detailed steps, look at: 

https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started
